reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Gym fees add up fast, and you don't need a fancy membership to get strong. Bodyweight work, a pair of adjustable dumbbells, or a resistance band set can cover most of what a basic gym gives you. If you tell me how many days a week you can train, how long a session you want, and what equipment you have at home, I can build you a program around it."}
